name: bws-sidechat
description: Side chat in the right-hand pane: /fork (or /branch) and /btw open a copy of this conversation beside it, answered by a forked headless session so the main conversation is never touched. /explain turns the last reply's options into a decision tree you explore in forks.

takeOverFork.title: /fork and /branch open the side chat
takeOverFork.description: Off: they stay Claude Code's own fork. /side always opens the side chat; /fork native always runs the built-in fork.

takeOverBtw.title: /btw answers in the side chat
takeOverBtw.description: Off: /btw stays Claude Code's own side question.

sideTools.title: Tools the side chat may use
sideTools.description: Comma-separated tool names allowed without asking (the side chat cannot ask). Anything else is denied. Read-only by default.

sideModel.title: Side chat model
sideModel.description: Default model alias or id for the side chat and its decision-tree forks. Empty: the session's model. The pane's model buttons (or /side model <name>) override it for the open side chat.

loadMcpServers.title: Load MCP servers in the side chat
loadMcpServers.description: Off (default): the side chat starts with no MCP servers, which is much faster. On: it loads every configured server.

claudePath.title: claude executable
claudePath.description: Path or name of the claude executable the side chat runs (not the npm .cmd shim).

chordAction.title: Chord action for 'open the side chat'
chordAction.description: An engine keybinding action the footer's side button borrows; bind a chord to it in ~/.claude/keybindings.json (Global), e.g. "ctrl+x ctrl+o": "app:cycleDiffBase". Default app:cycleDiffBase, which nothing else handles while the diff pane is closed. Empty hides the button.

exploreTimeoutSeconds.title: Decision tree: Explore time limit (seconds)
exploreTimeoutSeconds.description: An Explore fork that has not answered by then is ended and its node marked failed.

treeDumpFile.title: Decision tree: state dump file
treeDumpFile.description: Empty (default): off. A path: the tree is written there as JSON after every change (for checks and probes).
